title: [Quick Accent] Fix Unicode Description row centering

proposed_comments.title: The centering assertion measures the block rather than the rendered text
proposed_comments.body:
**This assertion can pass when the text is no longer centered.**

The UI Automation bounds here are for the `TextBlock`, not its rendered text. Removing only `VerticalAlignment="Center"` leaves the default `Stretch`: the block fills the star row between equal 8-DIP margins, so the assertion still sees equal gaps, while the text is drawn at the top of the block.

Could the test compare the visible line bounds (for example, UIA `TextPattern` range rectangles) or use a focused visual assertion? It should fail when just the alignment property is removed.
